projectTitle: Design and Implementation of a Secure Campus Network with Centralized Services

devices.label: R1-CAMPUS
devices.role: Four campus VLAN gateways, DHCP relay, ingress ACLs, area-0 OSPF, PAT outside 198.51.100.1 and SSH management

devices.label: SW1-CORE
devices.role: Layer 2 campus aggregation and Services access

devices.label: SRV-CAMPUS
devices.role: Centralized DHCP, DNS and internal HTTP services

devices.label: R2-EXTERNAL
devices.role: Area-0 OSPF neighbor and external LAN gateway; no route to private campus subnets

devices.label: SRV-EXTERNAL
devices.role: External HTTP demonstration server reached through OSPF routing and PAT

policies.caveat: Server responses use 67 → 67 for relay and 67 → 68 for direct client replies.
UDP DNS was exercised; TCP DNS remains not-run.
HTTP is unencrypted; this is a connectivity demonstration.
Server echo requests toward clients are handled separately.
Gateway diagnosis is allowed.
This does not permit arbitrary Administration-initiated application sessions.

policies.enforcementPoint: ADMIN-IN where routed; VTY ACL 1 on all IOS devices
policies.caveat: Local user authentication and SSHv2 are still required.

policies.enforcementPoint: VTY ACL 1; routed ingress ACLs where applicable
policies.caveat: Administration clients and all switch management addresses share VLAN 10; their packets bypass the router.
Echo replies to Administration and allowed DHCP traffic are exceptions.
Echo replies to Administration and allowed DHCP traffic are exceptions.

policies.portOrType: DHCP; DNS replies; HTTP replies; echo-reply
policies.caveat: Stateless packet matching; TCP established checks ACK/RST flags.
Allowed for server gateway diagnosis.
The ICMP initiation case was exercised against a known-live Student PC.

policies.enforcementPoint: Explicit final deny in all four routed ingress ACLs
policies.caveat: Only explicitly listed routed services are permitted, including ICMP and HTTP to the external demonstration server. Same-VLAN forwarding bypasses R1.

policies.enforcementPoint: SSH-only VTY transport; ingress ACL where applicable
policies.caveat: SSH-only VTY transport is configured on all five IOS devices; an expanded Telnet transaction was not recorded.

policies.source: Two endpoints in the same VLAN
policies.enforcementPoint: Layer 2 switching; router ACLs are not traversed
policies.caveat: Students are not isolated from other Students in this design.

policies.enforcementPoint: Client ingress ACLs, PAT and WAN-IN
policies.caveat: The external route is learned through OSPF; PAT supplies a return address.

policies.enforcementPoint: Client ingress ACLs, PAT and WAN-IN
policies.caveat: HTTP is permitted only to the demonstration server, not every outside destination.
The measured other-host denial targets the live R2 server-LAN interface, 203.0.113.1.
Permitted replies are distinguished from unsolicited requests; ACLs remain stateless.
The external LAN is passive. OSPF is not enabled on campus client VLANs.
This reachability failure is caused by the missing route. It is not evidence of an ACL match.
